title: Browser mockup with living hero
description: Rounded, shadowed browser window on a blue-grey backdrop showing a landing page whose hero illustration is a living cinemagraph; cursor clicks the CTA, page scrolls.
useFor: Product / website showcases, "here is the site" beats, SaaS launch videos, portfolio pieces.
notes: heroSrc = your real screenshot or hero art.

subtitle.default: Turn still artwork into pages that breathe, so every visit feels like the first time.

ctas.doc: button labels; the first is the filled primary the cursor clicks

features.doc: feature card titles shown after the scroll

heroSrc.doc: public/ image for the hero (empty = procedural etched lighthouse scene)

heroTint.doc: gradient-map the hero image to ink/paper so it matches the page

glint.doc: [x, y] fraction of the hero where the star glint sits (image hero only)

backdrop.doc: [highlight, top, mid, bottom] studio backdrop colours

chrome.doc: show the browser top bar (traffic lights + URL)

scroll.doc: how far the page scrolls (fraction of the viewport, 0 = no scroll)

title: Card fan: deal & play / connect
description: Cards deal from a pile into a fanned hand, one is hovered, played to centre and hits an enemy (white flash, slash, damage pop, HP drain); 'connect' mode links three glass cards' icons and merges them.
useFor: Game / deck-builder reels, feature cards, "these pieces connect" data stories, choosing an option.

mode.doc: 'hand' (deal, hover, play, hit) or 'connect' (three glass cards linked then merged)

cards.doc: hand cards {title, cost, icon, text, color}; icon = alarm|train|toast|flask|button|moon|sun|coffee|bolt|heart|star|gear|chat|leaf|check|flame|shield|sword

damage.doc: damage number shown on the hit

status.doc: status text that rises after the damage

energy.doc: energy orb value before playing (drops by the card cost)

title: Chat bubbles, chips & thought bubble
description: Chat bubbles and comment / prompt chips pop in one by one around a box-bot, a speech balloon snaps on, then a thought bubble rises (dots -> cloud -> icons -> caption) and a green verdict chip drops in.
useFor: Conversations, user feedback / comments, "what people are asking", a character thinking back over its day, verdict reveals.

default.text: it forgot what it just did

messages.doc: [{text, kind, at?}] kind = user (dark bubble) | reply (orange, flies from the bot) | chip (orange prompt chip) | comment (white ink chip) | speech (comic balloon); at = start frame

stagger.doc: frames between messages when `at` is not given

thoughtIcons.doc: icons that pop into the thought cloud (alarm|train|toast|flask|button|moon|sun|coffee|bolt|heart|star|gear|chat|leaf|check|flame|shield|sword)

thoughtCaption.doc: caption typed under the thought cloud

verdict.doc: text of the green chip that drops in at the end ("" = none)

title: SMS thread on a phone
description: A phone rises in beside a headline; a missed-call alert, typing dots and SMS bubbles pop in one by one and the thread scrolls like a real chat, with day notes and a verdict badge springing in under the headline.
useFor: Product explainers that show an automated text conversation, follow-up sequences ("Day 2 / Day 5"), booking confirmations.
source: original (Leadlatch explainer); bubble pop timing after video12 chat-bubble-pop

default.text: Sorry we missed you! What do you need help with?
Boiler's leaking, can you come Thursday?

messages.doc: [{text, from, at?, tag?}] from = us (right, ink bubble) | them (left, white bubble) | note (small centred "DAY 2" divider) | alert (orange missed-call pill); tag = small mint line under a bubble

stagger.doc: frames between messages when `at` is not given

typing.doc: frames of typing dots before each us/them bubble (0 = none)

contact.doc: name in the thread header (its first letter fills the avatar)

contactSub.doc: small line under the contact name

kicker.doc: small tracked mono line above the headline ("" = none)

title.doc: headline beside / above the phone; \n splits lines

subtitle.doc: body line under the headline ("" = none)

badge.doc: mint verdict pill that springs in under the headline ("" = none)

badgeAt.doc: frame of the badge (-1 = 24 frames after the last message)

paper.doc: headline colour and text colour in "us" bubbles

src.doc: optional public/ image shown blurred and dimmed behind

dim.doc: how strongly the background colour covers `src` (0..1)

phoneHeight.doc: landscape phone height as a fraction of frame height

title: Split-screen compare
description: Presentation layout: headline, two perfectly synced panels (line-art vs colour by default) with colour-coded labels, stat lines and a footnote.
useFor: Before/after, A vs B, two tools / two styles / two renderers of the same thing.

headline.default: Same blueprint, two ways to draw it

subheadline.default: Same scene, same camera, same timing. Only the renderer changes.

footnote.default: ※ Export time = time to turn the finished 8-second animation into an MP4.
footnote.doc: small grey footnote at the bottom

left.doc: {label, color, desc, stat, src, style} for the left (top in portrait) panel; style lines|color|mono|sepia|warm

image.doc: public/ image shown in both panels when a side has no own src (empty = procedural plate)

layout.doc: 'panels' = two side-by-side (stacked in portrait) panels, 'wipe' = one frame with a moving divider

introWipe.doc: divider draws on and the panels open outward from it

push.doc: shared camera push amount over the whole motion (0.14 = +14 %)

fadeOut.doc: panels fade to black over the last 0.5 s (chrome stays)

build.doc: both panels are revealed in sync by a rising scan line after the intro
